title: Rush Rodding of Femur in a Child with Osteogenesis Imperfecta Under Caudal Anaesthesia and Sedation: A Case Report
abstract: Osteogenesis imperfecta presents with unique challenges to the anaesthetist. We report a case of osteogenesis imperfecta, posted for rush rodding of femur managed with caudal anaesthesia and sedation with dexmedetomidine and ketamine.
